title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Sara del Nido Budish is Assistant Director of the Harvard Negotiation and Mediation Clinical Program (HNMCP), and a Lecturer on Law at Harvard Law School. She supervises student teams in the Dispute Systems Design Clinic, which partners with client organizations and communities to help them engage conflict effectively. Sara also teaches courses on conflict management […]
